# A01 native launch assets

The dedicated `SplashA01Brand` image catalog preserves the original colors with explicit original rendering intent. Its image view uses full opacity. The image filenames retain their exported scale mapping.

Original brand group exported from Figma Page 1 > 261007 > A01 (`111:3384`) in file `svNWsTFh8Ws1Mpt8XQIcrN`. The transparent group contains only the original logo and tagline, not the screen or OS indicators.

The 1x, 2x and 3x images retain the exported 232×89pt group and original Ria Sans glyphs.

Since #180 (2026-11-02) the logo rows are shifted right by 3, 6 and 8px (1x, 2x, 3x) so the letters without the sparkle are centered in the image, matching the app icon `189:4042`. Only pixel positions changed; the tagline rows are unchanged. The launch storyboard applies the yellow background and safe-area position separately.
